instruction: Add a note "BETA" into the slide and give the slide a magenta background color.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding note 'BETA' and setting background to magenta RGB(255, 0, 255). Evaluator checks both with partial credit (0.5 for note, 0.5 for color).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both requirements: note text 'BETA' (case-sensitive) and magenta background color RGB(255, 0, 255)
Getter logic correctly extracts note text from notes_text_frame and background color from slide.background.fill, handling both solid fill and master background scenarios
Metric logic correctly performs exact string comparison for note and exact RGB tuple comparison for background color
Partial credit scoring is appropriate: 0.5 for note match, 0.5 for color match, totaling 1.0 for complete success
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly (not nested) when expected.type='rule', and uses expected.get('note') and expected.get('bg_color') appropriately
Postconfig includes Ctrl+S to save the file before evaluation, ensuring changes are persisted to disk for getter to read
Edge cases handled: empty slides return empty note and None color, metric handles None values gracefully
Implementation is robust: RGB conversion handles both iterable and non-iterable types, case-sensitive comparison matches instruction hint
